Title: Rules question, a bit confused here

Messages.Author: MarkandJosie
Messages.Body:
In a game last Wednesday, my prey calls a Charming lobby, vote being
Kindred Restructure. Then during the block attempts, a Daring teh
Dawn is played to make it unblockable. At this point my predator
plays a Delaying tactics.

My question is, what in the heck happens? We had a bit of
confusion on this, I think finally we just ruled that the Daring the
Dawn does send the vampire to torpor, untapped, with kindred
restructure in hand, but not charming lobby. Was this correct?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

Yes.
And he player discards down to her hand size.
